tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The calm ground everything sits on.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs, listing photos' frame.

tokens.name: surface-sand
tokens.usage: Sand bands: search and filter bar, inputs, section dividers, the price breakdown box.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, card and input borders (decorative only; never the sole marker of a control).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings, on surface, surface-raised, surface-sand, peach and sage. 8.7:1 or better everywhere.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: seller name, item details, helper copy. On any surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata and timestamps on surface and surface-raised (4.9:1 / 6.9:1). On surface-sand use ink-soft instead.

tokens.name: taupe
tokens.usage: Line icons (heart outline, share, filter) on surface and surface-sand. Icons only; never body text.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: The one primary action per screen: Buy now, Sell now, Confirm handover. Fill only; label uses on-terracotta.

tokens.name: terracotta-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of a terracotta fill.

tokens.name: on-terracotta
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a terracotta fill (4.8:1 light, 7.7:1 dark). Never white: white on terracotta is 2.3:1.

tokens.name: terracotta-text
tokens.usage: Terracotta as text: links, 'Your turn' labels, active tab underline, a favourited heart. On surface and surface-raised (4.9:1+).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Verified tint: the background of Verified, Witnessed and Sealed badges, and completed custody steps. Text on it is on-sage.

tokens.name: on-sage
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sage fill (5.9:1 light, 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: sage-text
tokens.usage: Verified as text or icon (a tick, 'Chain intact') on surface, surface-raised and surface-sand.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Warm highlight: boosted-listing tag, price chip, onboarding callouts. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Decorative only: photo placeholders, illustration fills, empty-state shapes. Never carries text or meaning.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: The charcoal-olive bottom bar on phones and the camera viewfinder frame.

tokens.name: on-olive
tokens.usage: Inactive tab labels and icons on olive (5.4:1 light, 7.03:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-olive-active
tokens.usage: The active tab's icon and label on olive (4.9:1 light, 5.66:1 dark). Pair with the 3px indicator so state isn't colour alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, a broken custody chain, a disputed order. Text on surface and surface-raised; always with an icon or word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px so it always sits on the surrounding surface, never on the control. Over 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sand in both themes.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. Alias of terracotta-text, underlined.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Desktop home hero and empty-state headlines. One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Item title on the item page; page titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Packed in front of the courier on 9 Oct.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text, form labels, list rows.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices on cards and in the buy box. Tabular figures.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, timestamps, nav labels. Uppercase only for badges.

styles.name: evidence
styles.usage: Item codes, seal numbers, hash fragments, tracking numbers. Anything a person might read aloud to support.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a card, between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid gutter on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on phones; section padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gutter on desktop; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; space above page titles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, badges, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, listing photos, sheets, the price breakdown box.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, filter chips, the search field.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Phone bottom bar height, before the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the sticky buy bar only. Cards use no shadow.
